decisions.statement: The stem is the `slug` the page states rather than a title a reader would give the page.
A page naming itself otherwise than its file is invisible to the index.
A page's file states one page.
A page a file states past the first is invisible to the index.
Every page a file states past the first is said in one refusal.
A file with no page value is not judged.
A file is a page only where its own name states a page type.
A page property's file named for a property the index has in a file states no page type.
The index is asked only which properties are held in a file.
A file named for a group member is read against the keys that answer names.
That question is asked of the index as the change leaves the index.
That question is asked once for the whole run.
The name the page's value is bound to is judged against the export name its slug makes.
A value bound to no name is refused.
The name a file has is judged against the first page the file states.

definition: the check refusing a page whose file name or export name is not the name it states
